title: Earth: The Planet We Know Best
objective: After this level you can explain how Earth’s magnetic field and atmosphere protect life.
summary: A magnetic field from the molten core deflects solar particles; the atmosphere and ozone layer shield us; water covers 71%.

cards.headline: A magnetic shield
cards.body: Molten iron moving in Earth’s outer core generates a magnetic field. That field deflects most of the charged particles streaming from the Sun, which would otherwise strip away atmosphere and harm life. Particles that slip through near the poles make the sky glow as auroras.

cards.headline: Air and ozone
cards.body: Earth’s atmosphere is about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen. High up, the ozone layer absorbs most of the Sun’s harmful ultraviolet light before it reaches the ground.

cards.fact: About 71% of Earth’s surface is covered by water.
cards.context: So far, Earth is the only planet known to have life, and all of it depends on that water.
